stem.text: Which diagram correctly shows the electronegativity of the elements $\text{Na}$, $\text{Mg}$, $\text{Al}$ and $\text{Si}$ plotted against their first ionisation energies?

A.alt: Axes: electronegativity (vertical) against first ionisation energy (horizontal). Points rise steadily from Na (lowest, left) through Mg and Al to Si (highest, right).

B.alt: Axes: electronegativity (vertical) against first ionisation energy (horizontal). Na is lowest on the left, Al is upper-middle, Mg is lower-right and Si is highest at the far right.

C.alt: Axes: electronegativity (vertical) against first ionisation energy (horizontal). Na is highest at the top left, Mg is lower, Al is mid-height and Si is lowest at the far right.

D.alt: Axes: electronegativity (vertical) against first ionisation energy (horizontal). Na is highest at the top left, Mg is upper-right, Al is lower-middle and Si is lowest at the far right.
